description: This file implements vehicle speed measurement functionality for an engine control system, including methods to get vehicle speed, handle speed sensor input, initialize the speed measurement system, and mock speed for testing purposes.

methods.name: setMockVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Sets a mock vehicle speed value for testing purposes.

methods.name: getVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Returns the current vehicle speed in kilometers per hour, considering the mock speed and sensor availability.

methods.name: hasVehicleSpeedSensor
methods.description: Checks if the vehicle speed sensor input pin is assigned and available.

methods.name: stopVSSPins
methods.description: Stops the input signals for the vehicle speed sensor.

methods.name: startVSSPins
methods.description: Starts the input signals for the vehicle speed sensor and registers the callback for signal analysis.

methods.name: initVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Initializes vehicle speed measurement, sets up logging, and starts the VSS pins.

methods.name: vsAnaWidthCallback
methods.description: Callback function triggered on each VSS input signal, updates signal timing information.

methods.name: speedInfo
methods.description: Outputs current vehicle speed information via scheduled messages.
